caption: Next Stage Research Activities, Methodological Focus, and Expected Outcomes
rows: ⟪Consent Modification, Delegation and Lifecycle Extensions⟫

⦅Extend the implemented lifecycle mechanism to support consent modification, delegation and guardian-set changes, and formalise the state-transition model so that unauthorised transitions are excluded by construction.⦆ Evaluate access decisions under varying temporal and consent-state constraints.
A robust, dynamic consent management mechanism capable of validating whether an authorisation remains active at the precise point of access.

Formal Security Assurance
(Properties & Verification)

Formally define critical security properties and analyse system behaviour under adverse conditions, including invalid identities, insufficient multi-party approvals, policy violations, expired/revoked states, and illegal transitions.
A rigorous formal security model and verification proof establishing explicit security guarantees for the trust-oriented authorisation framework.

Comprehensive Empirical Validation
(HALAH Prototype Scenarios)

Scale and extend HALAH prototype experiments using representative positive and negative healthcare data-sharing scenarios. Measure and compare observed system runtime performance, overhead, and enforcement accuracy.
Empirical evidence and benchmark datasets demonstrating that the implementation consistently and efficiently enforces the proposed authorisation model.

Integrated Framework Evaluation
(Synthesis & End-to-End)

Integrate temporal, lifecycle, formal verification, and empirical modules into a unified, cohesive framework. Evaluate cross-component interactions, scalability bottlenecks, and end-to-end feasibility in real-world settings.
A fully integrated, validated ⟪trust-oriented authorisation framework⟫ providing secure, multi-party patient consent and decentralised healthcare data sharing.
